title: Suggestions: cursor-based pagination for list API + Console UI; faster large-tenant loads
author: Felix Schneider
description: Context: Several beta tenants have >5k suggestions once we start emitting per-(route,model,region) recommendations. The existing list implementation effectively behaved like offset pagination under the hood (and the Console requested too much at once), leading to slow loads and occasional timeouts in the BFF for large workspaces. This PR adds keyset/cursor-based pagination end-to-end (suggestions-service -> Console BFF -> Console UI), plus a few query/serialization optimizations to keep p95 list latency stable for large tenants. API: GET /suggestions now supports page_size (default 50, max 200) and cursor (opaque). Response includes next_cursor when more results are available. We continue to support the existing limit/offset query params for now, but the BFF/UI no longer uses them and we log a deprecation warning server-side when offset is provided. Cursor is computed from (sort_key, id) using base64url encoding; default sort is updated_at DESC then id DESC for deterministic paging. Backend: switch list query to keyset pagination and avoid COUNT(*) for list; add an index to support tenant_id + updated_at sorting; reduce per-row payload in list view (basis_of_estimate and long rationale moved to detail endpoint only). BFF: translate UI filters into v2 list params and plumb next_cursor. UI: table now loads first page and shows “Load more” (keeps scroll position); filters reset cursor; added “Showing 1–N” helper and improved skeleton sizing to reduce layout shift. Perf notes (staging): tenant with ~9,800 suggestions: list endpoint p95 dropped from ~2.6s -> ~310ms; payload size for first page reduced ~78%. This should also reduce Console time-to-interactive and cut down on transient 504s in the BFF during beta onboarding sessions. Follow-ups: (1) remove offset support after beta once all clients are migrated, (2) consider server-driven “total_count” only when explicitly requested by UI, (3) add contract tests to ensure cursor stability across schema versions (tracked in ENG-2410).
api_example: Request: GET /v1/suggestions?page_size=50&cursor=eyJ1cGRhdGVkX2F0IjoiMjAyNi0wMi0xMFQxODo0MzozMS4xMjNaIiwiaWQiOiJzZ18wMDE4M2YifQ  Response (excerpt): { "items": [ ...50 suggestions... ], "next_cursor": "eyJ1cGRhdGVkX2F0IjoiMjAyNi0wMi0xMFQxNzo1Nzo0My4wNDFaIiwiaWQiOiJzZ18wMDE3Y2EifQ" }  Notes: cursor is opaque; sort is updated_at DESC, id DESC; list items omit long explanation fields (available via GET /suggestions/{id}).

testing_notes: Verified locally with seed tenant of 10k suggestions: list endpoint returns stable ordering across pages; no duplicates/missing items when paginating; invalid cursor returns 400 invalid_cursor; UI filters reset paging and preserve scroll position when loading more. Staging verification: enabled suggestions_beta for large test workspace; first render ~1.2s -> ~0.4s; no BFF timeouts observed in 30 min exploratory session.
release_notes: Console Suggestions (beta): improved performance and stability for large workspaces by loading suggestions in pages; added “Load more” to the list and reduced initial payload size.
